extracted.intended_audience: eRA Commons users (Signing Officials, PD/PIs, PIs, Grants Management staff, NIH internal users, Reviewers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for initiating, routing, validating, submitting, and managing a Change of Institution Relinquishing Statement (RS) in eRA Commons, including roles/responsibilities (SO, PD/PI, internal users), business rules, required fields, routing order, and notifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: RPPR module features
rubrics_metrics.description: RPPR module features include: Electronic initiation of an RPPR; Electronic routing of an RPPR to authorizing officials at the applicant institution for review and approval prior to submission to the agency; Viewing of RPPR routing history; Error checking capabilities; Electronic submission of an RPPR; Creation of Final RPPR; Electronic submission of Final RPPR; Ability for an SO can delegate authority to a PD/PI for submitting an RPPR; PDF generated version stored in the electronic grant folder (Commons Status Information screen).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the NIH and Other PHS Agency RPPR Instruction Guide for detailed field-by-field guidance: https://grants.nih.gov/grants/rppr/rppr_instruction_guide.pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: IAR reviewer capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Internet Assisted Review (IAR) enables Reviewers to submit critiques, preliminary scores, and final scores and to view grant applications and related meeting materials via Commons. Reviewers may view critiques of others before the meeting unless conflicts of interest exist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IAR access is role-based; reviewers must hold the IAR role and be enabled for review meetings. IAR has its own online help system accessible via question-mark icons or directly at http://era.nih.gov/erahelp/IAR_Rev. Currently geared towards Reviewers; SRO help planned for future.

rubrics_metrics.name: xTrain access roles
rubrics_metrics.description: xTrain module provides online capabilities for working with trainee appointments and termination notices. Roles that can access xTrain: TRAINEE, PI, SO, BO, SPONSOR, ASST (when delegated by SPONSOR or PI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: xTrain has its own online help system accessible via question-mark icons or at http://era.nih.gov/erahelp/xTrain.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative Supplement Request features
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative Supplements module allows authorized staff to initiate, edit, delete and route an Administrative Supplement request; view an Administrative Supplement request; view routing history.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the Commons Online Help System or the eRA Commons Administrative Supplement Module User Guide for more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility of grants for relinquishment
rubrics_metrics.description: All awarded and active grants are eligible to be relinquished except for ones with the following statuses: 02 – Withdrawn; 21 – Ineligible organization - application withdrawn; 30 – Withdrawn by Institute/Center (IC); 34 – Administratively withdrawn by IC prior to review or council.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subprojects, Institutional Allowances, and Supplements are excluded from being eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: RS submission scope (activity code)
rubrics_metrics.description: RS(s) may be submitted for any activity code.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to Change of Institution option (SO authority)
rubrics_metrics.description: Only users with the SO authority at the grantee institution can access the Change of Institution option on the Commons Status screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The RS can be accessed only by the SO for grant applications from their grantee institution eligible for transfer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority to submit RS to Agency
rubrics_metrics.description: Only the SO for the grantee institution has the authority to submit the RS to the Agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: PD/PI access when current reviewer
rubrics_metrics.description: The RS can be accessed by the PD/PI for grantee applications where the PD/PI role is the current reviewer of the RS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the SO initiated the RS and routed it to the PD/PI, then the PD/PI can review, edit specific fields, save and route the RS back to the SO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal NIH user access and edit privileges
rubrics_metrics.description: The internal user can access the RS in Submitted or Accepted for Consideration status and is able to update the New Institution Name, IPF code and DUNS number of the new institution to which a grant is relinquished.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relinquishing Statement reviewer permissions for SOs
rubrics_metrics.description: Any SO at the grantee institution is able to create, review, edit, save, route, and submit the RS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relinquishing Statement routing order (default next reviewer)
rubrics_metrics.description: The next reviewer in the list of valid next reviewers is always the contact PD/PI on the application. The current user is not shown in the list of valid next reviewers on the RS. If SO is the current reviewer, then the contact PD/PI is the next reviewer by default.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the PD/PI is the current reviewer, the SO who initiated the RS is the first and default entry in the list on the RS. All other users with the SO role appear alphabetically by last name after the first entry. The information displayed for each valid next reviewer is: Name (LAST, FIRST).

rubrics_metrics.name: Unlimited routing between SO and PD/PI
rubrics_metrics.description: The RS can be routed back and forth between the SO and the PD/PI for an unlimited number of times.

rubrics_metrics.name: PD/PI verification not required for submission
rubrics_metrics.description: PD/PI verification is not required. The SO is able to submit the RS without routing it to the PD/PI.

rubrics_metrics.name: PD/PI edit capability limited
rubrics_metrics.description: The PD/PI has edit capability only for the New Institution Name information and Contact information in the New Institution Section of the RS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validation timing and behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Saving the RS does not execute any validations. The RS is validated upon submitting it to the Agency. The exception is that new Institution data is validated upon routing the RS by the PD/PI to the SO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The RS cannot be submitted to the Agency with validation errors, but the RS can be submitted to Agency with validation warnings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-award RS cost validation exception
rubrics_metrics.description: RS(s) submitted for pre-award are not validated for the costs relinquished. They can be zero or the original application’s requested funds amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple RS submissions rule
rubrics_metrics.description: The system allows multiple RS submissions. The SO is able to submit a new RS only if no RS has been submitted or if the existing RS(s) have been acknowledged (Accepted for Consideration or Refused status) by the Grants Management Specialist (GMS) user.

rubrics_metrics.name: RS deletion rule
rubrics_metrics.description: The RS can be deleted by the SO from the relinquishing institution if it is in the SO Work In Progress (WIP) state and has never been submitted to the Agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deleting the RS removes all data associated with the RS and returns to the Manage Relinquishing Statement screen. Deletion requires clicking Delete and confirming the action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visibility of submitted/accepted RS versions
rubrics_metrics.description: All submitted and accepted versions of the RS(s) are visible to the receiving institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeline: new-institution application after RS
rubrics_metrics.description: Grant applications for the new institution should be submitted within thirty days after the Relinquishing Statement is submitted from the former institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeline: RS relative to new-institution application
rubrics_metrics.description: The Relinquishing Statement should be submitted within thirty days of the grant application for the new institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required fields when completing RS
rubrics_metrics.description: Required fields are noted by an asterisk. The following fields are required: New Institution Name, Contact Email at the Institution, Requested Termination Date (MMDDYYYY), and Direct Cost $.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type 'NONE' in the Equipment Transferring with the Project section if there is no equipment to be transferred.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for receiving institution guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Click the Search button in the New Institution Name section to search for the receiving institution within the NIH eRA Commons database. If the receiving institution is found, click on the receiving institution’s IPF Code and the system inserts the receiving institution’s name, DUNS number and IPF Code in the appropriate text boxes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a new institution is registered with eRA Commons, it is highly recommended to choose it from the search results. DUNS Number and IPF code are pre-populated from the institutional profile file. The IPF Code links the submitted RS to the receiving institution and makes it viewable for SO at the receiving institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unregistered receiving institution handling
rubrics_metrics.description: If the receiving institution is not registered in eRA Commons (IPF Code not provided), it may not be able to view the relinquishing statement until it is registered in eRA Commons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The New Institution needs to register in eRA Commons and contact the eRA Service Desk for assistance in linking the relinquishing statement to the new institution account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Route to PD/PI process and notification
rubrics_metrics.description: SOs can route the relinquishing statement to the PD/PI. To route: click Route to PI, optional enter comments, select the Route to PI button. The system displays confirmation and sends an email notification to the PD/PI regarding the RS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After routing, Status of RS displays PD/PI Work in Progress. If routing canceled before completion, status displays SO Work in Progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit RS: SO-only and certification requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Only an institution's Signing Official can submit a Relinquishing Statement to the Agency. At submission the Certification Acceptance Statement is displayed and must be agreed to (I Agree) to submit. Certification includes willingness to terminate the grant as of Requested Termination Date, to relinquish unexpended funds and recommended future support, and a statement certifying truthfulness and awareness of penalties for false statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If Cancel is clicked, message explains RS will not be submitted without agreement to Organization Certification and Acceptance statement. After agreeing, the system displays 'The Relinquishing Statement has been submitted to NIH.'

rubrics_metrics.name: RS PDF generation and post-submission routing
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon submission the system creates the RS PDF file. If generation takes 30 seconds to 2 minutes an informational message appears. The next reviewer becomes an internal NIH user and the Status of RS displays Submitted to Agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For post-awarded and post-review applications, email notifications are sent to the centralized IC mailbox, the currently assigned GMS, and the PO. For pre-review applications, email notifications are sent to the Division of Receipt and Referral (DRR), the SRO if assigned, and the receiving institution contact email provided on the RS electronic form.

rubrics_metrics.name: PD/PI editing and routing back to SO
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Relinquishing Statement is routed to a PD/PI, the PD/PI may edit only the institution information and contact email address, save, and route the RS back to the SO. To route back, select Route to SO; if New Institution Name missing a warning is displayed; if IPF not provided another warning is displayed advising registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When routing to SO, the Next Reviewer is the relinquishing SO; if multiple SOs exist, the Next Reviewer drop-down selects appropriate SO and names display as last name, first name. An email notification is sent to the selected SO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signing Official search/view RS workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: SOs search for a grant to relinquish via Status – Change of Institution screen using required fields (at minimum Institution Code and Serial Num), click Search, then Manage Relinquishing Statement to Start a new RS or Edit an RS in SO WIP or Returned status. If RS has been routed to PD/PI or submitted to Agency, View and View Routing History links appear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If RS has not been submitted to NIH, viewing displays non-editable form. If submitted, RS displays in PDF in a separate window.

rubrics_metrics.name: View Routing History statuses
rubrics_metrics.description: View Routing History screen may show statuses depending on where the RS is in the process: SO Work in Progress, PD/PI Work in Progress, Submitted to Agency, Returned, Accepted for Consideration, Submitted to Agency and Linked, or Accepted for Consideration and Linked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for RS submitted by former institution behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: SOs can search for Relinquishing Statements submitted by the former institution. If no search parameters are entered, the search returns all RS(s) linked to the current institution by IPF. If the current institution has not been registered with Commons before the RS is submitted, the search does not return results until the RS is updated with the IPF and/or DUNS number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If no RSs have been associated, a warning 'No relinquishing statements have been associated with your institution. Please contact eRA Service Desk.' appears.

rubrics_metrics.name: Viewing RS PDF and missing document handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Click the Relinquishing Statement hyperlink to view the Relinquishing Statement PDF. If the PDF file does not exist, the system displays 'Document Not Found.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Email notification to new institution contact
rubrics_metrics.description: When an RS is submitted, an email is sent to the new institution contact email provided on the RS electronic form with subject 'eRA Commons: Relinquishing Statement for Grant <Grant Number> Submitted' and content informing them the RS was submitted electronically and instructions to view it via Change of Institution Search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Email explains NIH prior approval requirement for transfer, need for proposed new grantee to submit change of institution application via Grants.gov, registration instructions if not in eRA Commons, and contact info for eRA Help Desk and Grants Management contacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confirmation email to PD/PI & SO acknowledging NIH receipt
rubrics_metrics.description: A confirmation email is sent to PD/PI and SO (who actually submitted the RS) with subject 'eRA Commons: Relinquishing Statement for Grant <Grant Number> Submitted' indicating the RS was electronically submitted to NIH and may be viewed in eRA Commons. It instructs how to access the RS depending on role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Email states NIH must review and acknowledge the receipt of the RS before a change of institution can be processed and provides eRA Help Desk contact info.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relinquishing Statement Routed email notification
rubrics_metrics.description: When an RS is routed to a next reviewer, an email notification is sent with subject 'eRA Commons: Request That You Review Relinquishing Statement for Grant <Grant Number>' to the PD/PI or SO selected as the next reviewer.
